span.p: One merge, and nothing later touched its files

span.p: Otherwise

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
A current, unretracted statement
establishes this exact value

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
A listed rule applies, and every
premise is already a resolved fact

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
The user handed this over,
inside stated limits

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: Anything else

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: Yes

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: No

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(21, 57, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
A checkpoint at every turn boundary
WIP commit on refs/harness/checkpoints
Attempt branch harness/t/task/attempt
Session reference: Codex thread, Claude session, Cursor agent, or our transcript
Handoff note written by code: brief version, steps done and left,
files changed, last checks, last failing check
Ledger spend and reservations, settled
A limit, a crash or a closed laptop loses at most the turn in progress
Resume uses the runtime's own resume when it works
Otherwise a fresh session gets the brief plus the labeled diff
Sleep mid-turn: treat the call as unknown, resume from the checkpoint,
and reconcile an ambiguous paid call before retrying

div.style: color: rgb(64, 48, 11) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: Spend

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Alert only. The meter turns amber. One digest item

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Wind-down. No new attempts
Running attempts finish the current step
A reserve stays for checkpoints and for verifying finished candidates

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Every attempt checkpoints and parks
Office lights go to evening. This is not a failed task

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Same as stopped, with the reset time when it is known
Auto-resume only if the user enabled it

div.style: color: rgb(21, 57, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Stop card. Each option shows its estimate first
Add budget. Use cheaper models, previewing the remainder only
Switch connection. Wait for the reset. Keep parked
Finish by hand: export wip branches and the feature branch
of what was accepted, with the handoff in the app and
optionally beside the commit. Then I fixed it myself
A half-done feature is never landed. Landing with a feature
flag off is an explicit option, only if it was designed that way
Raising the budget resumes parked tasks in priority order
Nothing starts over. A retired model uses the roster fallback

div.style: color: rgb(21, 57, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Undo a merged feature is a current-feature change, not a blind reset
1 Inventory: commits, files, routes, exports, migrations, packages,
env, config, jobs, and external effects
2 Who else uses each piece: edges, imports, columns, later migrations
3 Classify. Only this feature: remove
Shared, including a feature mid-build: keep, and move ownership
Data: keep. Dropping is an explicit choice, export first,
and expand-then-contract
A package: remove only if nothing else imports it
An external effect cannot be undone. Show the receipts
A compensating action, such as unregistering a webhook, is a task if possible

div.style: color: rgb(64, 48, 11) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: How to execute the undo

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Revert that merge. Run the regression
Recorded as a forward revision, so it can itself be undone

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Removal tasks per area, verified like any other task,
then the regression of features that shared a boundary

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
On open, before anything runs, reconcile
Last revision, outbox, expired leases fenced
Missing worktrees recreated from checkpoints
New base commits, dirty files, branch switches, edits in worktrees
Lockfile and tool versions. Tokens, reset windows, prices, models
A CLI version change reruns the adapter conformance suite
Each open question is rechecked against the new commits and answers

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Welcome back. Finished while away. Parked, and why
Questions waiting, including one a commit may already answer
Your commits, and any overlap that will refresh a task
Connections. Budget left. Nothing runs until Resume
Review, or open the board, still starts nothing
Each question gets a recap: the decision, why it is needed,
and what the new commits changed. Older than a week: re-validate
Obsolete questions are retired with a note
Deleted checkpoint refs: those tasks restart from the brief
Finished work on integration stays. Abandoned export branches
remain theirs. The feature is marked abandoned

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Infer or ask, when a criterion is resolved, a worker or planner
meets a missing product decision, or a steer may change one
The kernel rejects a break of these rules. One object per criterion
Do not invent criteria. Propose a new gap separately, with its source

div.style: color: rgb(64, 48, 11) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Which status is actually earned?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
explicit. Cite the exact span
Your own earlier summary is not evidence

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
derived. Name the rule and the premises
No circular support. Never for a costly choice

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
delegated. Pick inside those limits
Record the reason. A recommendation alone is not this

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: missing, partial, or conflict

div.style: color: rgb(21, 57, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Quote, do not paraphrase. The quote must establish the value
Negation and retraction win. Keep digits and negations as spoken
Paid services, identity, retention, deleting data, and legal duties
are explicit, or an explicit bounded delegation. Never derived
One criterion at a time. Two readings is a conflict. Do not pick one
In an existing repo, code is today. The request is the change

div.style: color: rgb(64, 48, 11) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: Must a question be asked?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
One concrete question, in their words
The decision, why it matters, the options,
a recommendation when one is clearly safer, and something else
If two readings change behavior, show both

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Return id, status, value, evidence, rule, premises,
delegation, missing detail and question

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Before returning: a stranger would agree each explicit quote
establishes that value. Every derived value names a rule and
resolved premises. No costly choice is derived
Nothing is credited from a retracted or superseded span

svg.text: Budget stops, undo, coming back, and infer or ask
